nodes.name: File.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements the File class wrapping an underlying SdFile from sdfatlib. Provides file operations: read, write, peek, available, flush, seek, position, size, close, isDirectory, name, openNextFile, rewindDirectory, and boolean conversion.
nodes.languageNotes: wraps sdfatlib; uses malloc/free for SdFile allocation

nodes.name: File::File(SdFile, const char*)
nodes.summary: Constructor. Copies an SdFile into a heap-allocated buffer and stores the file name (up to 12 chars).
nodes.languageNotes: malloc for SdFile; strncpy for name

nodes.name: File::File(void)
nodes.summary: Default constructor. Creates an empty File with null file pointer and empty name.

nodes.name: File::name
nodes.summary: Returns a pointer to the file name string.

nodes.name: File::isDirectory
nodes.summary: Returns true if the underlying SdFile is a directory.

nodes.name: File::write(uint8_t)
nodes.summary: Writes a single byte to the file via write(&val, 1).

nodes.name: File::write(const uint8_t*, size_t)
nodes.summary: Writes a buffer of bytes to the underlying SdFile. Returns bytes written or 0 on error.

nodes.name: File::peek
nodes.summary: Reads one byte without advancing the file position (uses seekCur(-1) to step back).

nodes.name: File::read()
nodes.summary: Reads and returns a single byte from the file, or -1 on failure.

nodes.name: File::read(void*, uint16_t)
nodes.summary: Buffered read of up to nbyte bytes into a buffer. Returns number of bytes read.

nodes.name: File::available
nodes.summary: Returns the number of bytes available to read (size - position), capped at 0x7FFF.

nodes.name: File::flush
nodes.summary: Syncs the underlying SdFile to persist writes.

nodes.name: File::seek
nodes.summary: Seeks to an absolute position in the file.

nodes.name: File::position
nodes.summary: Returns the current read/write position in the file.

nodes.name: File::size
nodes.summary: Returns the total size of the file in bytes.

nodes.name: File::close
nodes.summary: Closes the underlying SdFile, frees the heap-allocated SdFile pointer, and resets to null.

nodes.name: File::operator bool
nodes.summary: Boolean conversion operator. Returns true if the underlying SdFile is open.

nodes.name: File::openNextFile
nodes.summary: Iterates through directory entries, skipping deleted entries and '.' entries, and returns the next file as a File object.

nodes.name: File::rewindDirectory
nodes.summary: Rewinds a directory file back to the first entry for re-iteration.

nodes.name: SD.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements the SDClass wrapper for sdfatlib and helper functions for path traversal. Provides begin/end initialization, open, exists, mkdir, rmdir, remove operations on SD card files via the FAT filesystem.
nodes.languageNotes: uses sdfatlib; path traversal with getNextPathComponent/walkPath callbacks; SPI card init

nodes.name: getNextPathComponent
nodes.summary: Parses individual path components (e.g. 'foo', 'bar', 'baz' from '/foo/bar/baz') into a buffer. Returns true if more components remain after this one.
nodes.languageNotes: MAX_COMPONENT_LEN = 12; similar to strtok but non-modifying

nodes.name: walkPath
nodes.summary: Traverses a file path component by component, calling a callback at each level. Alternates between two SdFile handles to avoid recursion. Stops traversal if callback returns false.
nodes.languageNotes: callback-based; non-recursive; swaps between two file handles

nodes.name: callback_pathExists
nodes.summary: Callback for walkPath that checks if a file/directory exists by attempting to open it read-only.

nodes.name: callback_makeDirPath
nodes.summary: Callback for walkPath that creates a directory if it does not already exist.

nodes.name: callback_remove
nodes.summary: Callback for walkPath that removes a file at the last path component.

nodes.name: callback_rmdir
nodes.summary: Callback for walkPath that removes a directory at the last path component.

nodes.name: SDClass::begin(uint8_t)
nodes.summary: Initializes the SD card at half SPI speed: inits card, volume, and opens the root directory.

nodes.name: SDClass::begin(uint32_t, uint8_t)
nodes.summary: Initializes SD card with a custom SPI clock speed after half-speed init.

nodes.name: SDClass::end
nodes.summary: Closes the root directory, allowing re-initialization with a new card.

nodes.name: SDClass::getParentDir
nodes.summary: Traverses the path to find the parent directory of a file, returning an SdFile handle and setting index to the offset of the filename within the path.

nodes.name: SDClass::open
nodes.summary: Opens a file by full path. Traverses to the parent directory using getParentDir, then opens the file component with the given mode. Supports append mode by seeking to end.

nodes.name: SDClass::exists
nodes.summary: Returns true if the given file path exists on the SD card.

nodes.name: SDClass::mkdir
nodes.summary: Creates a directory hierarchy (equivalent to mkdir -p) using walkPath and callback_makeDirPath.

nodes.name: SDClass::rmdir
nodes.summary: Removes a directory hierarchy (equivalent to rm -rf) using walkPath and callback_rmdir.

nodes.name: SDClass::remove
nodes.summary: Removes a file by path using walkPath and callback_remove.

nodes.name: SD.h
nodes.summary: Declares the File and SDClass wrapper classes for sdfatlib. File wraps SdFile with read/write/seek/iterate methods. SDClass manages the SD card lifecycle (begin, end) and file/directory operations (open, exists, mkdir, rmdir, remove). Provides global SD object and SDFile/SDFileSystemClass typedefs.
nodes.languageNotes: namespace SDLib; uses AdvancedTechnologyAttachment for card; SdFat.h dependency

nodes.name: File
nodes.summary: Wraps an SdFile with name tracking, read/write/peek/available/flush/seek/size/close operations, directory iteration, and boolean conversion.

nodes.name: SDClass
nodes.summary: SD card controller class wrapping sdfatlib. Provides init (begin/end), file open, exists, mkdir, rmdir, and remove. Uses AdvancedTechnologyAttachment (ATA) for hardware access.
nodes.languageNotes: global SD object; uses ATA driver for hardware
